summary: More than most people, a need to be seen and to matter and a strong will and deep reserves of energy are fused in you - you can't run one without the other. At your best, you shine and lead without trying and you go after what you want and don't back down. At the edge, you make it all about you, or you shrink when no one's looking.
body: More than most people, a need to be seen and to matter and a strong will and deep reserves of energy are fused in you - you can't run one without the other. At your best, you shine and lead without trying and you go after what you want and don't back down. At the edge, you make it all about you, or you shrink when no one's looking. Initiative and drive; the cost is friction with authority and a tendency to force things.
gift: At your best: you shine and lead without trying, and you go after what you want and don't back down.
shadow: The trap: you make it all about you, or you shrink when no one's looking, or your temper gets ahead of you, or you sit on it, then unload on whoever is nearby.
integration: Let identity and drive and anger cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Initiative and drive; the cost is friction with authority and a tendency to force things.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you shine and you go after what you want work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: You make it all about you
Let the reflex make the decision
